main_text.p: ta conscripserit,ediderit; videlicet quum hæreret,in scholis Romanen-sium,postea autem longè alium se-se probavit: valeat itaq; illud 1.Cor. 6.11. Hæc quidem fuistis,sed jam san-ctificati estis. responsum plenum qui desiderat,legat notas Bezæ in N.Testam.Matth.1.de verbo μεταδαιμονιζων [?]. 9 Lutherum confiteri, quòd à diabolo esset edoctus, Missam priva-tam esse rem malam,ac protinus Diabolicatiónibus convictum abolevuse eam. Resp. Delrius Jesuita autem testatur lib.4.de Magia c.1. q 3.§.5.q Satan abbati comendaverit Missam,tanquam Deo charissimam. Apud Surium, inquit, liquet, Diabolum in specie angelica apparuisse & statum abbatem, ut Missam celebaret, hortabatur. Ergo quid de missa sit statuendum non quæratur ex satana, sed ex scripturæ seloquiis.
10 Protestantium doctores penitus oble-stare se & auditores suos meris calumniis, adeo ut si ex illorum libris su-stuleris calumnias & convitia, ex maxi-mis voluminibus vix exigui libelli effici

page.notes: Right edge: a strip of the facing page, cut off, with its marginal notes only partly visible; not transcribed. Doubtful readings marked [?]: the Greek word after "verbo" and the word "dictoriis" region of line 14 (not clearly legible, so "meris calumniis" is given as the most likely reading). The Greek is set in italic type with a Latin-letter approximation, so accents and letters should be checked against the scan. Item "9" and "10" are section numbers as printed.
